resolved_findings.reproduction: Import a valid CSV prefixed with UTF-8 BOM bytes EF BB BF; compare exported validation SHA with the raw-file SHA.
resolved_findings.expected: Hash file.arrayBuffer(), or label a decoded-text hash explicitly and preserve raw file identity separately.
resolved_findings.resolution: Actual UTF8BOM file-byte SHA matches validation export; decoded-text SHA differs as expected.
